description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Kekirawa Pradeshiya Sabha, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the schedule for the first official meeting to appoint the Chairman/Vice Chairman for the Kakirawa Local Government Authority. It is made under the Elections for Local Government Bodies Act and its amendments, specifically concerning the electoral process and post-election procedures for local government bodies. This content fits squarely within the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, including meetings for appointing officials following an election.
